NP.name: product novelty

levels.1R: Exact product connectivity registered or directly reported; R specifically identifies a database connectivity registration.
levels.1T: Only a registered standardized tautomeric relationship; not identical bond-order graph.
levels.2: Exact match not found in the bounded search, but key connectivity and nearby scaffold have primary precedents.
levels.3: No matching key connectivity/charge endpoint precedent in the searched scope.
levels.unresolved: Evidence insufficient to assign a level; retained, never imputed as zero.
levels.not applicable: Recorded input lacks the route-required site; not a novelty score or failure.

NP.scope: Proposed product connectivity/parent scaffold; no claim about stereochemical firstness or novelty of the purchased reagent.

NR.name: reaction novelty

levels.1: Same starting-substrate class, donor form and net transformation reported; original rubric allows an HRMS-supported proposed intermediate, which must be distinguished from an isolated product.
levels.2: Extension of a known reaction in substrate framework, donor or activation method.
levels.3: No matching target substrate–partner sequence established in the bounded search.
levels.range: Alternative endpoints retain their separate labels, e.g. 2–3; no averaging.

NR.scope: Starting substrate class, reactive donor form, net bond changes, endpoint and method; kept separate from NP.

definitions.calculation: Evidence-based ordinal classification using archived structure queries and nearest-precedent comparisons. Not an arithmetic score; NP and NR are not added, averaged or converted into a success probability.

data_sources_and_scope.registry: PubChem PUG REST same_connectivity; 202 stored query responses dated 2026-10-21
data_sources_and_scope.literature: Project literature collection and logged Crossref, Europe PMC and OpenAlex searches; accessible main text, SI, figures, author abstracts and patent abstracts were assessed at their available evidence level.
data_sources_and_scope.time_interpretation: The 21 October assessment and 23 October review are dated evidence audits. Their position after candidate generation cannot be recast as proof that these scores drove the original experiments.

retention_and_success.reason: No contemporaneous candidate-to-experiment selection/replacement chain or paired before/after choice records were recovered. Candidate hypothetical products and actual-input hypothetical products can also differ in electrophile and endpoint. Marginal distributions are descriptive and cannot identify retention or improvement attributable to Human-in-the-loop Evaluation.
retention_and_success.success_association: Not established: putative product identities and calibrated quantitative results are not uniformly verified; novelty is not a success probability.

special_cases.candidate_035: Both imidazole protonation states retained at parent-connectivity NP2 in the revised audit; salt-form novelty unresolved.
special_cases.candidate_086: All three phosphorus endpoints have NP unresolved in the revised audit; NR3 is retained.
special_cases.AP064: Carboxyl-O and phenolic-O options retain NP3/NP2 and NR3/NR2 separately; aggregated 3/2 and 2–3 are not scalar scores.
special_cases.AP043: Registered NP1R; NR is unresolved after recognizing direct trifluoropropanamide/indole prior art, pending the specific endpoint comparison.
